company.name: Evergreen Home Care
company.industry: Home care and social care services
company.summary: Evergreen Home Care provides home care in Glasgow. You and your team send carers to elderly clients' homes for personal care, medication reminders, and daily living support. You also run nursing, scheduling, recruitment, compliance training, and office functions to keep visits covered and records up to date.
offerings: Home care visits for elderly clients
Personal care such as bathing, dressing, and mobility support
Medication reminders and basic health monitoring
Dementia and memory support at home
company.customers: Elderly people and their families in Glasgow, often funded through local authorities or the NHS.

Microsoft 365 for email, documents, and spreadsheets
Payroll software such as Sage or Xero
HR and applicant tracking systems for recruitment
Learning management system for mandatory training records
Phone and messaging tools for on-call coordination

strategy.executive_summary: Evergreen Home Care runs 150 care workers across Glasgow with local authority and NHS funding, so small rota changes and record gaps quickly affect families and compliance. Your team already uses rostering software, mobile care notes, and Microsoft 365, but coordinators, seniors, and admin staff still spend hours on phone calls, spreadsheets, and chasing paperwork. The first wins are filling rota gaps faster, checking care notes, screening carer applications, and checking timesheets before payroll. Start with one or two agents in Care Coordination and Compliance, measure the hours saved, then add recruitment and finance. Keep humans approving care decisions and anything clinical.

maturity.label: Developing
maturity.note: You have rostering and mobile care notes in place, and Microsoft 365 is used across the office. Much of the rota, recruitment, invoice, and compliance work is still manual or spreadsheet based, so there is room to add simple agents without replacing your main systems.

opportunities.title: Rota gaps filled faster
opportunities.description: An agent watches your rota for gaps and cancellations. It checks carer availability, skills, and travel time, then drafts messages to the best-matched carers and proposes a fill for a coordinator to approve.
before: Coordinator spots a gap or gets a sick call
Calls or texts carers one by one
Waits for replies and checks travel time
Updates the rota system
Rings the client about the change
after: Agent flags the gap and suggests matched carers
Agent drafts SMS or email to carers
Agent collects replies and ranks options
Human: Coordinator confirms the fill and updates the rota
Agent logs the change and drafts a client update

opportunities.title: Care notes checked before they become problems
opportunities.description: An agent scans mobile care notes each evening for missing entries, medication gaps, and changes in condition. It drafts a short exception list and follow-up messages for seniors to review.

Issues are emailed or mentioned in handover
Action log updated by hand
Manager reviews at month end
after: Agent scans all notes nightly
Agent flags missing medication, falls, or skin issues
Agent drafts follow-up messages to carers

Agent updates the action log

risks.mitigation: Use approved systems, limit access by role, keep audit logs, and sign off with your data protection lead before launch.

risks.risk: Care quality could suffer if staff trust drafts without checking
risks.mitigation: Keep human approval for care plans, medication, incidents, and family clinical questions. Spot-check agent output weekly.

risks.risk: Staff may not use the agents
risks.mitigation: Start with coordinators and seniors who feel the pain, give short training, and show time saved in their own rota.

risks.risk: Integration limits with rostering or care notes software
risks.mitigation: Check API access first. If no API, use email or spreadsheet exports and keep the first version simple.

risks.risk: Too many alerts or wrong matches
risks.mitigation: Set clear rules, start with one team, and review false positives after two weeks before expanding.
